data.credibility: Management does not have a recorded ledger of prior explicit guidance in the provided material, making it impossible to evaluate direct target-hitting history from past calls. However, reported financial and operational delivery has been exceptionally strong across revenue and margins.
bull: Revenue compounded at an impressive 50.6% annually over five years, reaching ₹22,001 cr in TTM revenue.
EBITDA margin widened dramatically from 4.4% in FY21 to 18.7% in FY26, supporting a high ROCE of 28.3%.
Operating cash flow reached 123% of reported profit over 5 years, while debt-to-equity remained low at 0.3.
bear: Growth is slowing down noticeably, with three-year revenue growth dropping to 34.5% compared to 50.6% over five years.
Working-capital days stretched unfavorably from -14 to -2 over the past 5 years.
Valuation is demanding with a high P/E ratio of 88.1, alongside heavy concentration in apparel at 86.05% of revenue.
